text:
alex: CI red: hosted-integ (staging). Failing auth + streaming + tool-call tests. @nina @asha can you take a look? https://ci.redwood.dev/patches/5523

ci-bot: build #5523 - hosted-integ - FAILURE
Failed tests: auth/token-refresh.test.js (401), stream/connect.test.js (RST_STREAM), tools/tool_schema.test.js (AssertionError)
Logs: https://logs.redwood.dev/5523

nina: looking now. initial glance: lots of 401s from auth-proxy right after token-rotate @samir rolled earlier -> suspect token signing key mismatch

asha: which shard? I can rerun just the failing shard.

alex: shard: hosted-integ-4 (tests 120-160). repro steps:
```
export REDWOOD_ENV=staging
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

ben: grabbed a failing log: stream side closed with: PROTOCOL_ERROR then RST_STREAM 2
Also tool schema test shows assert: expected 'tool_call.input' to be object but got string — looks like schema change in model-bridge PR #998

nina: good call. @samir did a key rotate at 03:12UTC per ops. If tests still use old token they will 401. Two immediate options: revert rotate or update CI secrets. Which is faster?

asha: I can update CI secret to new key and rerun shard. Will do now.

ci-bot: rerun requested: hosted-integ-4 queued by asha (job 5523.2)

asha: patched CI secret (REDWOOD_AUTH_SIGNING_KEY) to new value, kicking rerun

ci-bot: job 5523.2 - hosted-integ-4 - STARTED

alex: also can we gate tool schema changes? if bridge changed 'tool_call.input' shape we need a compat layer. I'll open hotfix PR to coerce string->object for now.

ben: snippet from failing assertion:
```
AssertionError: expected type 'object' but got 'string' at tools/tool_schema.test.js:42
  actual: "{\"query\":\"x\"}"
```

nina: rerun green? update: 5523.2 passed auth tests but stream still flaky (intermittent RST). Investigating network/connectivity between runtime and proxy.

asha: If streaming still flakey after auth fix, we should run a short canary on staging runtime with increased logging. I'll spin one up.

alex: plan: (1) CI secret update applied (asha) (2) open hotfix PR for bridge compat (alex) (3) run streaming canary + collect pprof/logs (asha + nina) (4) if streaming not fixed, fallback to previous runtime image in staging.

ben: I'll bisect the bridge PRs for schema change — starting from master -> HEAD to find offending commit.

ci-bot: job 5523.2 - hosted-integ-4 - COMPLETED (partially green — auth/tests pass, stream tests failing)
Full logs: https://logs.redwood.dev/5523/2

nina: assigning owners: asha (CI secret/reruns + canary), alex (bridge hotfix), ben (bisect + tests), nina (runtime-proxy investigation). Ping me if you need extra ops help.

asha: on it. will report back in 20m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: :thumbsup:
